The question asks: "Quel énoncé utilise l'imparfait de politesse avec « vouloir »?" (Which statement uses the polite imperfect with "vouloir"?)

The "imparfait de politesse" is a French grammatical construction where the imperfect tense is used to make requests more polite. Instead of using the present tense "Je veux" (I want), the imperfect "Je voulais" (I wanted/would like) softens the request.

Choice B uses "Je veux" (present tense), which is direct and not the polite form.
